full.description: This gross specimen image shows the upper body and head of a stillborn fetus. Two loops of the umbilical cord are wrapped tightly around the fetal neck. The fetus exhibits signs of maceration, with skin slippage and discoloration. The findings are characteristic of a fetal death associated with a nuchal cord.

random.description: This image is a gross pathology specimen photograph showing a fetus with the umbilical cord wrapped tightly around its neck. The umbilical cord forms a nuchal cord entanglement. This finding can lead to fetal distress, hypoxia, or stillbirth in utero. The specimen is displayed against a blue background with a metric scale ruler at the bottom.
